text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Music Advisory Committee state that the Committee will hold up to four meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chair on the delegation of the Chair. City staff will propose dates for public meetings of Toronto Music Advisory Committee in 2024, for member feedback and discussion.
That the Toronto Music Advisory Committee: 1. Approved the following 2024 Meeting Date: Tuesday, February 13, 2024 Tuesday, May 14, 2024 Tuesday, September 24, 2024 Wednesday, November 20, 2024
